title: Licensing Office, Kent
hook: Both cats on the seat. The doors are open.
scene: You parked in the Kent licensing lot because the license is the thing you came for. Gracie is on the passenger seat, cream chest, paws tucked. Mya is beside her, heavier, green eyes half shut. They came because they always come. The building is ahead through the mesh. The doors are propped. There is no line. There are no cars. The counter beyond the glass has nobody at it. The counter is empty. That is the end of the plan you drove here with. You have not gotten out yet.
debrief: You came for the license. The cats are with you because they always are. The doors are open and nobody is at the counter. That is as far as this goes.

source.teaching_target: Establish the DOL lot: she is here for the license, both cats are with her, and the building is wrong. End before she understands.

image_brief.subject: parked cockpit of the Pink Menace, both cats settled on the passenger seat, a small municipal licensing office ahead through the windshield
image_brief.foreground: worn black wheel rim, cracked pink dash, Gracie the orange tabby and Mya the brown mackerel settled together on the passenger seat — Mya only slightly heavier than Gracie, normal large-cat proportions matching her ref, not obese, not a balloon belly; no seatbelt coming out of the dash
image_brief.midground: welded steel mesh over the windshield, analog gauges at rest, no clipboard on the mesh, door and pillar continuous with the body
image_brief.background: a small gray municipal office building — glass pedestrian entrance doors ajar a foot or two, not garage bays, not drive-through service doors — empty lobby/counter faintly visible, no line, no other cars, wet asphalt, flat gray overcast
image_brief.read: parked, both cats on the seat, the office doors ajar and nobody at the counter
extra_negatives: no Mya filling half the seat alone
no belt rising from the dashboard

geometry.ego_lane_side: parked in a stall in an empty licensing lot, not in a travel lane
